human_quote: Je valide T01–T08 et tes propositions TC01–TC04. Enregistre mes décisions, clarifie la spécification et vérifie sa cohérence avant l’implémentation. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.
approval_basis: One actual collective human message approving T01-T08 and the four preceding TC proposals; not twelve independent approval exchanges.

approved_technical_choices.T01: Strict versioned structured input; separate application-produced canonical request; no caller source-policy override.
approved_technical_choices.T02: Four explicit slot states, decimal-string quantities, declared units, no automatic conversion.
approved_technical_choices.T03: Explicit product/technique catalog and aliases; no approximate resolution; ambiguity, known out-of-scope and unresolved identity distinct.
approved_technical_choices.T04: Source-role adapter preserving task, stage, information and facet ownership.
approved_technical_choices.T05: Atomic source/dependency/guard bundles, joint E118-USE/C/M clarification support and mandatory E120-W workflow warning.
approved_technical_choices.T06: Rank admissible candidates by new coverage, product specificity, column specificity then BM25 tie-break; no raw/relative lexical cutoff.
approved_technical_choices.T07: Per-information partial outcomes and complete blocking reasons.
approved_technical_choices.T08: Global six-root/2048-token budget including source metadata and task/information bindings; deduplicated shared sources.

approved_clarifications.TC01: Retain all scoped reasons and distinguish input interpretation, documentary support and assembly. Unknown context must not hide known quarantine; clarification cannot lift quarantine.
approved_clarifications.TC02: Represent explicit binding/elution formulation comparison as two preparation items in one task, each with scalar buffer-use facet, without pairing formulations.
approved_clarifications.TC03: Preserve contradictory assertions and their origins within the same scenario; clarify affected units, no last-wins or automatic split. Separate only explicitly distinct scenarios.
approved_clarifications.TC04: Require deterministic conformance coverage of states/units/identity conflicts, exclusions/ownership, atomic dependencies/quarantines, partial results/deduplication/global budgets before freezing and preparing prospective evaluation.

clarification_encoding.unit_result: Retain summary state; require independent interpretation_state/documentary_support_state, scoped issue_ids and all dimensioned diagnostics.
clarification_encoding.contradictions: Preserve malformed-semantic duplicate/conflicting facts in input snapshot; semantic issue blocks affected units without silently rewriting the input.
clarification_encoding.conformance: CF01-CF12 specify future implementation acceptance checks, not executed planner tests or a new prospective benchmark.
clarification_encoding.identifier_policy: Preimplementation identifiers containing proposed are retained for traceability; updated technical-design status and this decision are authoritative.
clarification_encoding.catalog_utf8_correction: Restored intended French accents and typographic/straight apostrophe aliases using explicit UTF-8 I/O; corrected double-decoding in the local draft, not product scope or source quotations.

not_approved_or_performed: No runtime implementation, interpreter, form or graph migration.
No new source approval, real-sample suitability, laboratory authorization or removal of quarantine.
No prospective dataset, performance threshold or measured success.
No retrieval/planning run, model/API call, Git commit or push.

consistency_verification.scope: Declarative document/schema/catalog/adapter consistency only; no semantic planner implemented or executed.
consistency_verification.not_executed: CF01-CF12 semantic/planner acceptance suite, retrieval or benchmarks; these require future implementation.
